Needs the epoch-wide appliance wrangle consumer: feral machines wind down when kited long enough and may then be captured alive. The browser enables WrangleSystem for the whole Atomic epoch, while the headless sim has no wrangle consumer and the mechanics manifest exposes no capture operation.

The headless door composes the atmosphere wall and, since 2026-09-07, the HUMAN suit: the hero drains outside a breathing dome, refills only inside one, and loses five hit points a second once it empties, through CombatSystem. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so a player there meets neither the suit nor the harm, and this dependency stays missing until Game.ts composes it.

Signal suppression, probe recovery and playback have consumers, and the headless door composes the suit-only atmosphere wall. Since 2026-09-07 the body it measures is the HERO: her suit drains outside the landing yard, refills only inside it, costs five hit points a second once empty, and the crossing into the probe crater is hers to make. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so a player there meets neither the suit nor the harm, and this dependency stays missing until Game.ts composes it.

Zero-gravity projectile physics, the scaffold decks, the debris bands and the handhold spine all run, and the headless door composes the suit-only atmosphere wall. Since 2026-09-07 only the carcass yard holds air, the two outboard decks are vacuum, and the hero herself must cross to them on her own suit. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so a player there meets neither the suit nor the harm, and this dependency stays missing until Game.ts composes it.

The headless door composes the atmosphere wall and the eclipse event: mid-run the shadow takes the solar-fed dome pads offline, leaves the pad nearest the claim as the reserve, and the secure then needs a regolith ground worked on the hero air after it lands. Since 2026-09-07 the suit is hers and an empty one costs five hit points a second, so the reserve is a life-support ration rather than a bookkeeping note. The authored shadow-zone rectangle itself still has no consumer, and the BROWSER composes neither the atmosphere nor the eclipse, so this dependency stays missing.

Needs the scheduled moving-column relocation and objective consumers declared by this contract.

SATISFIED 2026-08-21 by A10 (src/systems/CanalChoiceSystem.ts, live in both engines): the profile-persistent segment choice, the derived flow and the objective latch all exist. The row survives because the schema has no status but 'missing' and DECLARED_INERT_PATHS obliges a non-empty list while twist.persistentCanalChoices is declared - see F-A10-2.

BOTH CONSUMERS LANDED AND THE CLAIM IS EARNED: the squall phase machine in both engines (E10S-2, src/systems/E10SquallScheduler.ts, now.squall) and the warmth meter, STOKE action, gutter terminal, doubled mote pressure and secure latch in both engines (E10S-3, src/systems/E10PreserveSystem.ts, now.emberShore.preserve); E10S-4 added the harvestAnchors, the bench seeds, two losing null-floor rows and the public-verb prover, so the map is admitted. F-E10S4-2 CURED 2026-09-07: twist.emberShore is OUT of DECLARED_INERT_PATHS and the validator now ACCEPTS removing this row, measured rather than assumed (artifacts/engine-correctives-batch/probe-inert-retire.mjs run with the row deleted: 42 contracts load and parseContractDescriptor returns ok=true with no reasons). THE ROW SURVIVES FOR A NEW, SMALLER REASON: scripts/e10-preserve-consumer.test.mjs:455 pins it as a landed row naming its slice, and that guard sat outside the curing task's firewall. Retiring it is now one ledger line plus that guard's own retirement.
